Your unit-variance zero-mean prior balanced the likelihood at MAP 1.500. Weakening it to τ=2 moved MAP to 2.400, closer to observation 3. Changing prior mean to 2 instead pulled toward 2. Priors need not shrink toward zero; this is a specified Gaussian model.
